title: Use Sol's native function calling instead of XML-emulated tools
hypothesis: Giving GPT-5.6 Sol structured function definitions and correlated function outputs improves grounded agent behavior without making simple prompts invoke tools unnecessarily.
falsified_if: Native calling does not materially improve project-orientation evidence and outcome scores, fails to complete a multi-step tool turn, or causes any simple arithmetic run to use a tool.
deterministic_outcomes: authoritative repository inspection before orientation answer
correct project identity and operating model
successful native call-id continuation across tool results
no tool call for simple arithmetic
decision_rule: Adopt native calling for Sol only if five-run cells show at least 4/5 project-orientation passes, no simple-prompt tool calls, no protocol failures, and better mean orientation score than XML without a material latency regression. Then validate editing and auth implementation separately before making it the interactive default.
